name: Sour Vampirebat 66
author: gharsh11032000
description: Rounded purple toggle switch that toggles on and off when clicked.
howItWorks: Clicking it toggles it: background changes from #d4acfb to #b84fce, transform becomes translateX(1.6em), width becomes 2em. On focus, box-shadow becomes 0 0 1px #b84fce.
